explanation: I found no Mathlib match. The theorem is stated almost entirely in terms of the library's own definitions: `PairOfSubspacesUnitaryEquivalent`, `SameHalmosTrivialDimensions`, `compactAngleEigenvalueList`, `genericCosineBlock`, `angleSequenceDatum`, `AngleSequenceSpace` and `sourceSubspace`. Mathlib has no theory of the unitary classification of pairs of subspaces (the Halmos two-subspace theory) and no prescribed angle sequences in this sense. The proof only rewrites with two of the library's own lemmas (`corollary3_1_compact_defectBlock_angleList_classification_real` and `compactAngleEigenvalueList_genericCosineBlock_angleSequenceDatum`) and then applies `eq_comm`. I didn't search Mathlib, because none of the statement's main constants exist there, so no Mathlib declaration could carry this content.
